title: Mega Menu Panel
description: The fold-out panel behind a header mega menu — the group at the root of parts/mega-menu-*.html. Carries the panel's own frame: its vertical padding and the size of its column headings. Everything else about a panel lives in one of three other places, deliberately. The row contract is in styles/blocks/{navigation/mega-menu-nav,query/mega-menu-list}.json. The column hairlines, the featured card and the hover flips are in assets/styles/ollie-mega-menu.css, keyed off the sd-mega-panel class, because a sibling border, a pseudo-state and a media query are the three things a css field cannot hold. And every blockGap stays on the block markup, per AGENTS.md — a variation's own blockGap is emitted nowhere, and a nested one is emitted on the front end only, so the editor and the front end would disagree.
